protocol: Nine terrains, matched default joint/root states verified across policies. No noise or pushes; fixed10ms delay. 71 cases per policy: 20 all-direction flat starts (6s budget), seven other terrain types at L6/L9 and vx0.3/0.6/1.2, pit0.6/0.9/1.2m at vx0.3/0.6/0.9 (25s budget). No heading feedback. Pit external stop retained. 50Hz trajectories plus per-step 200Hz torque/speed/hard-limit peaks. Fixed cases, not success probabilities over random trials.
